Name: Arms of the Spider
Components: M, V (A dead spider, curled into a ball)
Duration: Until dispelled or the cocoon is
Description: destroyed. You conjure the disembodied gigantic, spindly legs of a spider near a target creature within range. It must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer from the spider perfectly weaving a Cocoon around most of its body, rendering it grappled until the Cocoon is broken. On a success, the creature takes 2d4 piercing damage as the legs nick its body from the rampant movement. The Cocoon has 50 hit points, 12 AC and weakness to fire damage. After being destroyed the Cocoon slowly crumbles into white dust.
